questions.question: In the Sermon on the Mount, what did Jesus say is the problem with storing up treasures on earth?

answers.text: Moth and rust destroy it and thieves steal it
Tax collectors come and take half of it
Kings seize it to pay their armies

questions.question: Jesus taught that no one can serve two masters. He said you cannot serve both God and what?
Jesus said birds do not plant or harvest crops. According to Him, how do the birds get fed?

answers.text: They take grain from the farmers' barns
They fly to wherever fields are full

questions.question: Jesus told people not to worry about food and clothes. What did He say they should seek first?

answers.text: The kingdom of God and His righteousness
The treasures of earth and their glory
The favor of men and their praise
